title: International Day of Clean Air for blue skies 2026
text:
When: 7 September 2026

Where: Worldwide

▶︎ Register your event

This year's campaign spotlights new findings from Hidden assets: The economic and health case for climate and clean air action, released by UNEP and the Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC).

This year's observance underscores the clear economic case for integrated climate and clean air action in support of healthier populations and economic prosperity. The report shows how coordinated action can improve public health, strengthen economies, and accelerate progress on climate goals through 25 proven measures and policy reforms.

As air pollution and climate change continue to threaten people, economies, and the planet, this year's Clean Air Day calls for action that delivers cleaner air, healthier lives, and shared prosperity.

Visit the official campaign page for more information.

The United Nations General Assembly designated 7 September as International Day of Clean Air for blue skies in 2019, with the first Day held in 2020. The UN General Assembly’s resolution stresses the importance of, and urgent need to, raise public awareness at all levels and to promote and facilitate actions to improve air quality.
